english.title: Enter / work in airside area at Luton Airport without wearing high visibility clothing / protective equipment
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) not being a bona fide passenger,

(A)_[entered]_
(B)_[worked]_

in an airside area of Luton Airport, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AREA..), without wearing

(C)_[high-visibility clothing to the standard designated by London Luton Airport Operations Limited]_
(D)_[personal protective clothing that met prevailing statutory requirements]_
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 2.42 and 7.1 of the London Luton Airport Byelaws 2005.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and place
not being a bona fide inbound / outbound passenger,
enter / work in an airside area of Luton Airport
without wearing high-visibility clothing
to the required standard OR
personal protective clothing
meeting prevailing statutory requirements

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
